<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Usage">Usage</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Carrot_on_a_Stick?section=3&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Usage" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Carrot_on_a_Stick?action=edit&section=3" title="Edit section's source code: Usage"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Riding_a_pig">Riding a pig</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Carrot_on_a_Stick?section=4&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Riding a pig" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Carrot_on_a_Stick?action=edit&section=4" title="Edit section's source code: Riding a pig"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>To use a carrot on a stick, the player must first <a href="/w/Saddle" title="Saddle">saddle</a> a <a href="/w/Pig" title="Pig">pig</a>, and ride it while holding the carrot on a stick. The pig then moves in the direction of the carrot. Also, if the player holds a carrot on a stick, all nearby pigs (but not <a href="/w/Rabbit" title="Rabbit">rabbits</a><sup id="cite_ref-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-1"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>1<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup><sup id="cite_ref-2" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-2"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>2<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>) follow the player, but they can't breed using a carrot on a stick.
</p><p>To make the pig run faster, the player can press <span class="explain" title="Defaults to right click on mouse or left trigger on controller.">use</span> while holding the carrot on a stick. This is called "boosting". Each boost costs 7 durability in <a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition"><i>Java Edition</i></a>, or 2 durability in <a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition"><i>Bedrock Edition</i></a>. If the carrot on a stick's durability is depleted, it turns back into a <a href="/w/Fishing_rod" class="mw-redirect" title="Fishing rod">fishing rod</a>. 
</p><p>The speed of a mounted pig is 2.42 m/s. Boosting a pig causes its speed to slowly ramp up until it reaches 2.15 times its normal speed, 5.20 m/s. Then speed slowly declines until the pig reaches normal speed again. The boost lasts between 140 and 980 game <a href="/w/Tick" title="Tick">ticks</a> (7 seconds and 49 seconds respectively), chosen randomly. No matter how many ticks the boost lasts, the average speed of pig during a full boost cycle is roughly 4.19 m/s. These boosted speeds are applied only while holding the carrot on a stick. These speeds are affected by the <a href="/w/Speed" title="Speed">speed</a> effect.
